what: DaVinci ground material ids of Apple's SPR tiles (chapter 155 material raster: pixel value -> stack of material ids) -> Landcover class of the sheet style whose fillColor the App's palette row shows
how: pipeline/basemap/spr_dump.m decodes the tiles; the class of each id comes from the z2 draws captured in-process on 2026-09-16 (basemap/data/shader/shader-numbers.json landcover_palettes, scratch cap-wide): the captured aridity textures identify the tile (diff 0 against the decoded attr154 rasters), the styleTexture row k is the base cell of stack k, and the row's colour is matched to the sheet's Landcover-*.Light-Elevated fillColor at Apple z2 (pipeline/basemap/styl resolve.py). Ids are the low 16 bits of the 64-bit id (high 48 = 0x110200000000, material family 0x1102).

226.sheet: Landcover-Herbaceous z2 rgb(165,219,118) lin #60b52e (d=11); Vegetation lin #63ba29 (d=12) is the runner-up

264.captured_lin: no colour change on top of another class; alone once: #9ddc6e

274.sheet: Landcover-Forest / DeciduousForest / EvergreenForest / MixedForest z2 rgb(146,213,98) lin #49aa1f (d=12; the z2-3 rows interpolated at the draw zoom explain the offset)

318.sheet: Landcover-Water; the material's own DvMt resource carries the depth->colour ramps (depths 0, 3, 10, 25, 50, 100 ... 7000 m)

330.sheet: Landcover-Vegetation z2 rgb(167,222,111) lin #63ba29 (d=12); Herbaceous is the runner-up (d=15)

30813.sheet: no sheet colour within 10 (nearest SportsClay lin #deded0 d=13, DryLake rgb(245,241,223) lin #e9e0bc d=20); id family 0x1102500b — appears on the salt flats / dry lakes of Iran, Central Asia, Australia, southern Africa and the Great Basin; painted with the captured colour

stack_rule: class = the last material in the stack that has a class; 264 / 310 never change the colour (modifiers); [223] alone = Ground, [318] alone = Water
dvmt: the DvMt resources are decoded (pipeline/basemap/dvmt.py -> ui/basemap/dvmt-materials.json): per material, colour bands by zoom under (client:1 day/night, client:69 map style 0 globe / 1 standard / 2 Elevated); style 2 = the sheet Landcover colours, style 0 = the Mac globe pastels; the resources themselves stay outside the repo
